$comment: Data for /ops/library/pipeline-walkthrough. The visual companion to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — the narrative, not live status. Both update together; /ops/standing (not this page, not ARCHITECTURE.md) is the source for whether a stage actually works today.
headline: Lead to invoice, end-to-end — and where it breaks
lede: Every stage of lead → score → site → preview → outreach → reply → deal → invoice, its moving parts, and an honest status. Built for the operator, not the archive.
thesis: Both ends are built — sourcing and scoring are live, outreach is scaffolded. But the middle is the broken link: the site actually gets generated (stage 3) and published (stage 4) has never run end-to-end. Until it does, there is no preview link to send. That middle — not the outreach engine — is the #1 build target.

stages.title: Source leads
stages.description: Scrape local businesses via Outscraper, normalize + score, upsert to Supabase. Proven: Run 01 = 249 leads, 25 qualified. Opt-out suppression is enforced on ingest.

stages.title: Score & qualify
stages.description: lead_score (need) + build_score (demo material); qualified at ≥ 60. The site-quality / redesign scorer (PageSpeed) is built but waits on a key + migration.

stages.title: Generate the site
stages.description: The agent (enrich → generate → judge) emits a ClientConfig. Triggered from the board, but never actually run on a real lead — and it produces a config, not a live site.

stages.title: Build & publish
stages.description: Duda is retired; the Astro clients factory is the replacement but isn't live yet (Cutover Part B). There is no working path from config → a published preview site today — this is the hole.

stages.title: Preview / client portal
stages.description: The /c/:slug?token= portal (server-side auth) shows the live preview + milestones + a feedback form. The lead's preview_url is the hook the outreach email points at.

stages.title: Outreach
stages.description: Smartlead adapter + push script (dry-run by default, compliance-filtered). Sending is gated on the key + a warmed sending domain (2–4 wk). The reply/bounce webhook is deferred (function cap + secret).

stages.title: CRM lifecycle & compliance
stages.description: Lifecycle columns + opt-out suppression + retention purge are built; they activate once migration 0007 is applied. B2B cold email is CAN-SPAM-legal; the privacy page is the open item.

stages.title: Deal → invoice
stages.description: The funnel's end. No won-deal → billing path exists yet — a future stage once the middle is closed and outreach is converting.

commandCenter.title: Cross-cutting · the command center (/ops)
commandCenter.heading: The dashboard everything runs from
commandCenter.description: Surfaces: leads · tasks · digest · projects · issues · clients · agentic-os home. Password-gated, with a machine-auth key for headless agents. The fleet view watches every Vercel deploy + repo status; the task board imports GitHub issues and dispatches them by @-mentioning Claude; every autonomous run posts a recap to the run-log. The pre-Ralph /admin/approvals inbox was retired 2026-07-13 (ops#157) — merge governance now runs through ralph-gate and the ops#238 boundary: green merges by default, a diff touching a supervised revenue path needs ralph-approved (enforced by scripts/ralph-watchdog.mjs; the engine's ralph-auto arm has no path check yet).
commandCenter.openNote: Open here: the autonomy dial and tier→model dispatch UI polish (#13).
